latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Challenger model rollout planning skill.

- Provides a structured, organization-wide plan for implementing the Challenger Selling Model, leveraging Grainger's four-question pilot framework.
- Integrates rep profile and manager effectiveness diagnostics as required inputs to shape rollout strategy.
- Guides users through pilot design, adoption sequencing (star/core/laggard), and parallel workstream planning (training, tools, coaching, manager enablement).
- Sets clear targets for 80% model adoption and anticipates 20–30% attrition with a backfill plan.
- Delivers a detailed 12-month milestone schedule as a rollout-plan.md artifact.
